### 🧪 Universal Zero-Red-Line Quality Gate
- [ ] **Diagnostic Scanner Passed**: Ran `node scripts/diagnose.js --strict --check-git` (or `python scripts/diagnose.py --strict --check-git`) with **0 errors**.
- [ ] **Diagnostic Test Harness Passed**: `node scripts/test-diagnose.js` and `python scripts/test_diagnose.py` passed **100% of test assertions**.
- [ ] **Compiler / Typecheck**: 0 red lines confirmed (`npx tsc --noEmit`, `mypy .`, `go vet ./...`, `cargo check --all-targets`).
- [ ] **Linter / Formatter**: 0 warnings or syntax errors (`npm run lint`, `ruff check .`, `flake8 .`, `cargo clippy`).
- [ ] **Test Suites**: Unit and integration test suites pass completely (`npm test`, `pytest`, `go test`, `cargo test`).
- [ ] **Secrets & Ignore Audit**: Verified no `.env` keys, tokens, or untracked private credentials staged.
- [ ] **Branch Safety**: Pushed to a dedicated branch (`feat/*`, `ui/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`, `perf/*`, `docs/*`), **NEVER** `main`, `master`, or `develop`.
